svg.title: Campus Cards · Set 10 · Santa Cruz · 04/12 The Lime Kilns (Uncommon)
svg.desc: Old stone kilns tucked in the trees, left from the ranch days. Moss has taken over the work. Unofficial. An independent PointCast art project about places. Not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by the University of California or any campus. No university logos, seals, mascots, or marks are used.
